name: OddCycleBound.mean_compressIter
statement:
lemma mean_compressIter (hU : IsGraphon U μ) : ∀ k, mean μ (compressIter U μ k) = 0
  | 0 => by
      show ∫ x, degCentered U μ x ∂μ = 0
      simp only [degCentered]
      rw [integral_sub (good_degree hU).integrable (integrable_const _)]
      show mean μ (degree U μ) - mean μ (fun _ => edgeDensity U μ) = 0
      rw [mean_const, edgeDensity]; ring
  | (k + 1) => by
      show ∫ x, compress U μ (compressIter U μ k) x ∂μ = 0
      simp only [compress]
      rw [integral_sub (good_kernelOp hU (good_compressIter hU k)).integrable (integrable_const _)]
      show mean μ (kernelOp U μ (compressIter U μ k)) - mean μ (fun _ => mean μ (kernelOp U μ (compressIter U μ k))) = 0
      rw [mean_const]; ring

    (A B : ι → Set α) (x : α) :
    |(s.sum fun i => c i *

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.hsym_append
statement:
lemma hsym_append (ys : List ℝ) : ∀ (xs : List ℝ) (d : ℕ),
    hsym (xs ++ ys) d = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), hsym xs j * hsym ys (d - j)
  | [], d => by
      simp only [List.nil_append]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem 0 (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.succ_pos d))]
      · simp
      · intro j _ hj
        rw [hsym_nil, ite_eq_right hj, zero_mul]
  | (x :: xs), d => by
      rw [List.cons_append, hsym_cons]
      simp_rw [hsym_append ys xs, Finset.mul_sum]
      simp_rw [hsym_cons, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_sigma', Finset.sum_sigma']
      refine Finset.sum_nbij' (fun p => ⟨p.1 + p.2, p.1⟩) (fun p => ⟨p.2, p.1 - p.2⟩)
        ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · rintro ⟨j, i⟩ hp
        simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range] at hp ⊢
        omega
      · rintro ⟨J, j⟩ hp
        simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range] at hp ⊢
        omega
      · rintro ⟨j, i⟩ hp
        simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range] at hp
        show (⟨j, j + i - j⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) = ⟨j, i⟩
        rw [show j + i - j = i from by omega]
      · rintro ⟨J, j⟩ hp
        simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range] at hp
        show (⟨j + (J - j), j⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) = ⟨J, j⟩
        rw [show j + (J - j) = J from by omega]
      · rintro ⟨j, i⟩ hp
        simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range] at hp
        rw [show j + i - j = i from by omega, show d - j - i = d - (j + i) from by omega]
        ring

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.sum_choose_hockey

lemma sum_choose_hockey (k : ℕ) : ∀ d,

  | (d + 1) => by

        Nat.choose_succ_succ (d + k + 1) k, show d + 1 + k = d + k + 1 from by omega]

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.dirExp_add
statement:
lemma dirExp_add : ∀ (L : List ℝ) (f g : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f → Continuous g →
    dirExp L (fun x => f x + g x) = dirExp L f + dirExp L g
  | [], f, g, _, _ => by simp [dirExp]
  | [c], f, g, _, _ => by simp [dirExp]
  | (c :: d :: L), f, g, hf, hg => by
      rw [dirExp_cons_cons, dirExp_cons_cons, dirExp_cons_cons,
        ← intervalIntegral.integral_add
          (dirExp_intervalIntegrable (d :: L) c f hf) (dirExp_intervalIntegrable (d :: L) c g hg)]
      refine integral_congr fun t _ => ?_
      rw [dirExp_add (d :: L) (fun x => f (t * c + (1 - t) * x)) (fun x => g (t * c + (1 - t) * x))
        (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
      ring

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.dirExp_nonneg
statement:
lemma dirExp_nonneg : ∀ (L : List ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), a ≤ b →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, 0 ≤ f x) → (∀ x ∈ L, x ∈ Set.Icc a b) → 0 ≤ dirExp L f
  | [], f, a, b, _, _, _ => by simp [dirExp]
  | [c], f, a, b, _, hf, hL => by
      rw [dirExp]; exact hf c (hL c (by simp))
  | (c :: d :: L), f, a, b, hab, hf, hL => by
      rw [dirExp]
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1)
      intro t ht
      have h0t : (0:ℝ) ≤ t

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.dirExp_param_continuous
statement:
lemma dirExp_param_continuous : ∀ (L : List ℝ) {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] (F : X → ℝ → ℝ),
    Continuous (Function.uncurry F) → Continuous (fun w => dirExp L (fun x => F w x))
  | [], _, _, _, _ => by simp only [dirExp]; exact continuous_const
  | [c], X, _, F, hF => by
      simp only [dirExp]
      exact hF.comp (show Continuous (fun w : X => (w, c)) from by fun_prop)
  | (c :: d :: L), X, _, F, hF => by
      simp only [dirExp]
      have hG : Continuous (Function.uncurry
          (fun (p : X × ℝ) (x : ℝ) => F p.1 (p.2 * c + (1 - p.2) * x)))

  | [], a, f => by simp [dirExp]
  | [c], a, f => by simp [dirExp]
  | (c :: d :: L), a, f => by
      rw [dirExp_cons_cons, dirExp_cons_cons, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.atomicIntegral_nonneg_of
statement:
lemma atomicIntegral_nonneg_of (w lam : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (P : ℝ → Prop) : ∀ (r : ℕ) (F : List ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ L, L.length = r → (∀ x ∈ L, P x) → 0 ≤ F L) →
      (∀ i, P (lam i)) → 0 ≤ atomicIntegral w lam r F
  | 0, F, hF, _ => by
      exact hF [] rfl (by simp)
  | r + 1, F, hF, hP => by
      simp only [atomicIntegral]
      refine Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hw i) ?_
      refine atomicIntegral_nonneg_of w lam hw P r (fun L => F (lam i :: L)) ?_ hP
      intro L hlen hL
      apply hF (lam i :: L)
      · simp [hlen]
      · intro x hx
        simp only [List.mem_cons] at hx
        rcases hx with rfl | hx
        · exact hP i
        · exact hL x hx

statement:
lemma blockWord_append_injective : ∀ (t t' : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (a a' : ℕ),
    blockWord t ++ List.replicate a false = blockWord t' ++ List.replicate a' false →
      t = t' ∧ a = a'
  | [], [], a, a', h => by
      simp only [blockWord_nil, List.nil_append] at h
      exact ⟨rfl, by simpa using congrArg List.length h⟩
  | [], p :: t', a, a', h => by
      exfalso
      have hmem : true ∈ blockWord (p :: t') ++ List.replicate a' false := by
        simp [blk, List.mem_replicate]
      rw [← h] at hmem
      simp [List.mem_replicate] at hmem
  | p :: t, [], a, a', h => by
      exfalso
      have hmem : true ∈ blockWord (p :: t) ++ List.replicate a false := by
        simp [blk, List.mem_replicate]
      rw [h] at hmem
      simp [List.mem_replicate] at hmem
  | p :: t, p' :: t', a, a', h => by
      simp only [blockWord_cons, blk, List.append_assoc] at h
      have hhd : ∀ (s : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (b : ℕ),
          (blockWord s ++ List.replicate b false).head? ≠ some true :=
        head?_blockWord_append
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩

lemma mem_listsOf {s : Finset α} : ∀ {r : ℕ} {l : List α},
    l ∈ listsOf s r ↔ l.length = r ∧ ∀ x ∈ l, x ∈ s
  | 0, l => by cases l <;> simp [listsOf]
  | r + 1, l => by
      cases l with
      | nil => simp [listsOf]
      | cons a l =>
          simp only [listsOf, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_product, Prod.exists,
            List.cons.injEq, List.length_cons, List.mem_cons, forall_eq_or_imp]
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨b, l', ⟨hb, hl'⟩, rfl, rfl⟩
            exact ⟨by rw [(mem_listsOf.mp hl').1], hb, (mem_listsOf.mp hl').2⟩
          · rintro ⟨hlen, ha, hl⟩

lemma run_unique (a : Bool) : ∀ (k k' : ℕ) (l l' : List Bool),

    List.replicate k a ++ l = List.replicate k' a ++ l' → k = k' ∧ l = l'
  | 0, 0, l, l', _, _, h => ⟨rfl, by simpa using h⟩
  | k + 1, 0, l, l', _, h', h => by
      simp only [List.replicate_succ, List.replicate_zero, List.nil_append, List.cons_append] at h
      rw [← h] at h'; simp at h'
  | 0, k' + 1, l, l', hl, _, h => by
      simp only [List.replicate_succ, List.replicate_zero, List.nil_append, List.cons_append] at h
      rw [h] at hl; simp at hl
  | k + 1, k' + 1, l, l', hl, hl', h => by

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.sum_fin_eq_sum_allWords

lemma sum_fin_eq_sum_allWords {β : Type*} [AddCommMonoid β] :
    ∀ (L : ℕ) (G : List Bool → β), ∑ w : Fin L → Bool, G (List.ofFn w) = ∑ l ∈ allWords L, G l
  | 0, G => by simp [allWords, listsOf]
  | L + 1, G => by
      rw [← (Fin.consEquiv fun _ : Fin (L + 1) => Bool).sum_comp, Fintype.sum_prod_type,
        allWords, sum_listsOf_succ]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
      show _ = ∑ l ∈ allWords L, G (b :: l)
      rw [← sum_fin_eq_sum_allWords L (fun l => G (b :: l))]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w _ => ?_
      simp [Fin.consEquiv, List.ofFn_succ]

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.tupleSum_eq
statement:
theorem tupleSum_eq (q : ℝ) (s : ℕ → ℝ) : ∀ r : ℕ,
    tupleSum q s r = conv (fun d => hsym (List.replicate r q) d) (momentConv s r)
  | 0 => by
      funext N
      rw [tupleSum_zero]
      unfold conv
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
      · simp only [List.replicate_zero, hsym_nil, ite_true, one_mul, Nat.sub_zero]
        cases N <;> simp
      · intro i _ hi; simp [hi]
      · intro h; simp at h
  | r + 1 => by
      rw [tupleSum_succ, tupleSum_eq q s r, conv_conv_conv_comm, List.replicate_succ,
        hsym_cons_eq_conv, momentConv_succ_eq_conv]

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.applyWord_replicate_true
statement:
lemma applyWord_replicate_true (hV : IsGraphon V μ) (c : ℝ) : ∀ β : ℕ,
    applyWord V μ (List.replicate (β + 1) true) (fun _ => c) =
      fun x => c * compressIter V μ β x
  | 0 => by
      show kernelOp (kerQ V μ) μ (fun _ => c) = _
      rw [kernelOp_kerQ hV ⟨stronglyMeasurable_const, ⟨|c|, abs_nonneg c, fun _ => le_rfl⟩⟩]
      have : (fun _ : Ω => c) = fun y => c * (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) y

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.compPow_eq_sum_listKer
statement:
theorem compPow_eq_sum_listKer (hV : IsGraphon V μ) : ∀ n : ℕ,
    compPow μ V n = fun x y => ∑ w ∈ allWords (n + 1), listKer V μ w x y
  | 0 => by
      funext x y
      rw [sum_allWords_succ]
      simp only [allWords, listsOf, Finset.sum_singleton]
      exact (kerP_add_kerQ x y).symm
  | n + 1 => by
      have hGV := goodK_of_isGraphon hV
      have hmem : ∀ w ∈ allWords (n + 1), GoodK (listKer V μ w) :=
        fun w _ => goodK_listKer hV w
      show comp μ V (compPow μ V n) = _
      rw [compPow_eq_sum_listKer hV n, comp_finset_sum_right _ hGV hmem]
      funext x y
      rw [sum_allWords_succ (n + 1)]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w hw => ?_
      obtain ⟨c, l, rfl⟩ : ∃ c l, w = c :: l

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.comp_eq_kerP_add_kerQ

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.comp_finset_sum_right

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.rowIntegral_wordKer

lemma rowIntegral_wordKer (hV : IsGraphon V μ) : ∀ (b : Bool) (l : List Bool),
    (fun x => ∫ y, wordKer V μ b l x y ∂μ) = applyWord V μ (b :: l) (fun _ => 1)
  | b, [] => by
      funext x
      simp only [wordKer, applyWord, kernelOp, mul_one]
  | b, c :: l => by
      funext x
      show ∫ y, comp μ (letterKer V μ b) (wordKer V μ c l) x y ∂μ = _

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.wordKer_append_single
statement:
lemma wordKer_append_single (hV : IsGraphon V μ) (b : Bool) :

      wordKer V μ c (l ++ [b]) = comp μ (wordKer V μ c l) (letterKer V μ b)
  | c, [] => rfl
  | c, d :: l => by
      show comp μ (letterKer V μ c) (wordKer V μ d (l ++ [b])) = _
      rw [wordKer_append_single hV b d l, ← comp_assoc (goodK_letterKer hV c)

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.qpCount_append
statement:
lemma qpCount_append : ∀ l₁ l₂ : List Bool, qpCount (l₁ ++ l₂) =
    qpCount l₁ + qpCount l₂ +
      (if l₁.getLast? = some true ∧ l₂.head? = some false then 1 else 0)
  | [], l₂ => by simp [qpCount]
  | [a], [] => by simp [qpCount]
  | [a], b :: l₂ => by
      simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append, qpCount, List.getLast?_singleton,
        List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq]
      ring
  | a :: b :: l₁, l₂ => by
      simp only [List.cons_append, qpCount]
      rw [← List.cons_append, qpCount_append (b :: l₁) l₂, List.getLast?_cons_cons]
      ring

  | [p], _ => by simp [qpCount_blk]
  | p :: p' :: t, _ => by
      rw [blockWord_cons, qpCount_append, qpCount_blk, getLast?_blk, blockWord_cons,
        head?_blk_append, ← blockWord_cons]
      have

  | 1 => rfl
  | k + 2 => by

        qpCount_replicate a (k + 1)]
      cases a <;> simp

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.sum_head_ne_true_eq

theorem sum_head_ne_true_eq (L : ℕ) (H : List Bool → ℝ) :

      ∑ r ∈ range (L + 1), ∑ N ∈ range (L + 1),
        if 2 * r + N ≤ L then
          ∑ t ∈ tuples r N, H (blockWord t ++ List.replicate (L - 2 * r - N) false)
        else 0

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.sum_lin_qp

      qpCount (List.ofFn v)
  | 0, v => by simp [List.ofFn_succ, qpCount]
  | n + 1, v => by

      have ih

theorem pathDensity_excursions (hV : IsGraphon V μ) (k : ℕ) :

      if 2 * r ≤ k then
        conv (fun d => hsym (List.replicate (r + 1) (edgeDensity V μ)) d)
          (momentConv (specMoment V μ) r) (k - 2 * r)
      else 0

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.pathIter_eq_sum_words
statement:
lemma pathIter_eq_sum_words (hV : IsGraphon V μ) : ∀ k : ℕ,
    pathIter V μ k = fun x => ∑ w ∈ allWords k, applyWord V μ w (fun _ => 1) x
  | 0 => by
      funext x
      simp [allWords, listsOf, applyWord, pathIter]
  | k + 1 => by
      funext x
      show kernelOp V μ (pathIter V μ k) x = _
      rw [pathIter_eq_sum_words hV k,
        kernelOp_finset_sum hV _ fun w _ => good_applyWord hV good_one w, sum_allWords_succ]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w _ => ?_
      rw [kernelOp_eq_kerP_add_kerQ hV (good_applyWord hV good_one w)]
      rfl

theorem trace_atoms_eq_weighted_moments
    (hW : IsGraphon W mu) (n : Nat) :
    (∑ t ∈ Finset.range n,
        ∫ x, compressIter W mu (n - 1 - t) x *
          degCentered (compPow mu W t) mu x ∂mu) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n,
        ((j + 1 : Nat) : Real) * specMoment W mu j *
          pathDensity W mu (n - 1 - j)

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.trace_compPow_eq_pathDensity_add_centeredTrace_add_atoms

    trace mu (compPow mu W n) =
      pathDensity W mu (n + 1) +
        trace mu (compPow mu (centeredKernel W mu) n) +
          ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n,
            ∫ x, compressIter W mu (n - 1 - t) x *
              degCentered (compPow mu W t) mu x ∂mu

theorem kernelOpCLM_compl_leading_eigenvalue_eq_hub_add
    (hW : IsGraphon W mu) (i : CenteredEigenIndex hW)
    {phi : Omega -> Real} (hphi : Good phi)
    (hrep : centeredEigenmode hW i = goodL2 (mu := mu) hphi)
    (hmean : mean mu phi = 0) :
    let hU := isGraphon_compl hW
    let c := inner Real (centeredDegreeL2 hU) (centeredEigenmode hW i)

      c • oneL2 (Omega := Omega) mu +
        complementEigenvalue hW i • centeredEigenmode hW i
